decision_1_whitelist_enforce.rationale: No admissible hypothesis exists (0/18 pass canonical harness). Flipping now or on 2026-05-26 accepts post-selection bias from same-sample re-aggregation (3-AI swarm flagged MAJOR_REVISION). Forward 200-close verification is necessary but insufficient without any admissible hypothesis. The canonical ledger shows CRYPTO PF 0.64 (n=1116) - ensemble block added to BLOCKED_ASSET_STRATEGY_PAIRS with −56.3pp PnL, indicating toxic volume already identified. Whitelist enforcement without causal validation risks blocking legitimate signals while bias remains unaddressed.
decision_1_whitelist_enforce.risk_if_wrong: Flipping prematurely locks in post-selection bias, potentially blocking profitable strategies while false positives from non-admissible hypotheses continue. Delaying until hypothesis admissibility ensures causal validity before operational enforcement.
decision_1_whitelist_enforce.evidence_cited: 0/18 hypotheses admissible (EFF_MIN=0.30, MIN_WINDOW_N=80, MIN_STABLE_WINDOWS=3, same-sign required); CRYPTO PF 0.64 n=1116; ensemble block −56.3pp PnL added to BLOCKED_ASSET_STRATEGY_PAIRS (commit 9834307); 3-AI swarm MAJOR_REVISION on same-sample re-aggregation; H-037 VIX-carry REJECTED on densification (118/130 windows, sign-unstable).

decision_2_fdr_gate.rationale: BH-FDR at q=0.10 is the minimum viable correction for the 18-hypothesis batch. Romano-Wolf is premature given 0 admissible hypotheses - compute cost unjustified. BH-FDR wires directly into tools/edge_stability_harness.py is_admissible() to adjust p-values before the 'proven' call. This addresses the 3-AI swarm's concern about multiple testing without over-engineering. Deferral (D) ignores the known multiple-testing problem - 18 hypotheses tested simultaneously inflates false discovery risk even with zero current admissibles.
decision_2_fdr_gate.risk_if_wrong: BH-FDR at q=0.10 may be too lenient if dependency structure is strong (e.g., correlated hypotheses from same asset class). However, with 0 admissibles, the immediate risk is low; tightening to q=0.05 or switching to Romano-Wolf can follow if false positives emerge after hypotheses become admissible.
decision_2_fdr_gate.wire_target: tools/edge_stability_harness.py: is_admissible() - insert BH-FDR adjustment on p-values from the 18-hypothesis batch before the EFF_MIN/MIN_WINDOW_N/MIN_STABLE_WINDOWS gate. Use statsmodels.stats.multitest.multipletests(method='fdr_bh').

consensus_hint: Both decisions hinge on the same root cause: zero admissible hypotheses under canonical harness. Until at least one hypothesis survives the full stability + sign-consistency + FDR-adjusted test, any operational flip (whitelist enforcement) or advanced correction (Romano-Wolf) is premature. BH-FDR is the minimal prerequisite to make future admissibility calls statistically valid.
